duration.text: The Traffic Engineering at Shandong University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1888 USD/per year ￥ 13600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Certificate of HSK (No need for English-medium program) Band 6 for Liberal Arts and Band 3 for Sciences. 2. Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 3. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 4. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 5. High school academic transcript 6. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: 1. Abide by Chinese Laws 2. Uner 40 of age 3. HSK 3 or above 4. In good health 5. With reliable financial support and custody.
